candidates.statement: Order service postgres connection pool is exhausted (size 5, idle 0), causing save_order to fail with DependencyUnavailable; order returns 503 and gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from trace attributes; no direct pool saturation metric or postgres-side evidence was admitted.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 preceded by order ReadTimeout and postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0; order metrics show 503s on /v1/orders and elevated p95 latency. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool utilization/saturation metrics for order service
Postgres server-side logs or connection counts during incident window
